description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class StoreLogoUrlTag that generates the URL for a store's logo image, either default or custom, based on the merchant store data and configuration.

classes.name: StoreLogoUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that constructs and outputs the URL for the store's logo image based on store data and configuration settings.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the image URL for the store logo, either default or custom, and writes it to the page output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Completes the tag processing and continues page evaluation.
